WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    m.Name,
    AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS DECIMAL(18,4)) / t.Milliseconds) as rate
  FROM Track t
  INNER JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds > 0
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
)
SELECT 
  Name,
  rate,
  rate / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM media_type_rates) as normalized_rate
FROM media_type_rates

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with Milliseconds ≤ 0 are excluded to prevent division by zero. The request specifies 'skip tracks where the ratio is missing'; since Bytes/Milliseconds cannot be computed when Milliseconds = 0, these are implicitly excluded.
